The owner keeps the device unplugged for the stress session and tells the campaign the starting battery level.
rows.pass: Memory flat within the declared resource budget over the session (the growth rule of feature 192), 200 samples per device; thermal state and any tier change recorded.
rows.procedure: Run the 30-minute round-two stress session of UA-F13 (levels opened, hinges turned with drags, double taps and the panel, hinges chosen with taps, actions undone and redone, the camera orbited, levels retried and replayed in a loop) at automatic levels; the campaign samples the footprint and the thermal state.
rows.title: Memory, thermal state and the round-two stress session

owner_steps: The owner has the device in hand, unlocked, trusted and charged; the automation build is installed by the campaign (signing is the owner's).
The owner taps cubes to choose their hinges, drags cubes to turn hinges, double-taps cubes and orbits with two fingers; the campaign does not synthesise touches on hardware.
rows.pass: Touch-to-frame latency recorded for 200 samples per device; a tap (travel under 10 points, lifted within 0.5 s) on a non-root cube chooses its hinge; a drag from a turnable hinge's cube while playing previews a quarter turn the way the swinging cubes follow (one step per 24 points of travel) and sends exactly one hinge.turn on release; a second tap on the same cube within 0.35 s and 22 points turns it forward once; a double tap on empty space restores the authored camera.
rows.procedure: Tap cubes to choose hinges, drag cubes to turn hinges both ways, double-tap a cube to turn it forward, orbit the camera with two fingers and double-tap empty space on each device; the campaign records the interval from touch to the first frame showing the change.
rows.title: Touch feel and touch-to-frame latency

owner_steps: The owner has the device in hand, unlocked, trusted and charged; the automation build is installed by the campaign (signing is the owner's).
The owner listens and feels, and sets the silent switch and the system haptics setting.
rows.pass: The sound is audible only while it is on, the panel is shown and the scene is active, and follows the silent switch; each planned haptic is felt (where the device has no haptic engine, the haptic part is recorded as not applicable).
rows.procedure: Turn the Sound toggle on and play a level to a win and to a failure with the haptics switch on, including one refused action (turning a hinge that would swing nothing, which the rules refuse); choose a hinge to hear its audition; observe the solid's ambient sound and the selection, success, warning and error haptics.
rows.title: Sound heard and haptics felt

rows.procedure: With VoiceOver on and the largest accessibility text size, choose a hinge with the adjustable hinge, turn it with Turn + and Turn − to hear each turn and the win; replay it.
rows.title: VoiceOver walk-through (manual, non-gating)
